content.short: Collectibles born from a group of authors with a great passion for technology, novelties and claiming the opportunity to act and dream freely.
content.description:
HipAliens is a collection of 7599 NFT unique digital collectibles living on the Cardano blockchain.

Your purchase of a HipAlien NFT works like a membership card and guarantees access to the benefits reserved for members. Each Aliens is unique and programmatically generated by over 100 traits, all carefully treated, but some are rarer than others.

The artistic line is essential and minimalist: the lines are strong, the colors are saturated, defined, sharp, the landscapes tend to be flat. It’s a fairy-tale, enchanted world.

The story begins with a departure, a journey from a remote place in space and time. But, as far and different as their world is, they are so extraordinarily like us, with strengths and weaknesses, the same as ours and very well known.

Without religion, country, color, sex, nation, so far and so similar, so strong and weak at the same time and finally so bloody aspiring to freedom. We are them, who we will always be.
